scripts.build:dev: node preflight.mjs && npx --yes eas-cli@latest build -p ios --profile development
scripts.build:preview: node preflight.mjs && npx --yes eas-cli@latest build -p ios --profile preview
scripts.verify: node verify-design.mjs && node verify-design.mjs --selftest && node preview/build.mjs && node preview/measure.mjs
scripts.preview: node preview/build.mjs && node preview/shoot.mjs && node preview/measure.mjs
scripts.push: node native-changed.mjs && npx --yes eas-cli@latest update --branch preview --auto
scripts.sync: git -C .. checkout -- app && git -C .. pull && npm ci
scripts.ship: npm run sync && npm run build:preview
scripts.update: npm run sync && npm run push
